Mysterria's own term, translated in the novel's register. DO NOT translate literally as 想象之环 or similar. The English name is a pun on 《宿命之环》(Circle of Inevitability), the sequel novel: swap Inevitability for Imagination and you get Minecraft's 'the only limit is your imagination'. 空想之环 keeps the pun intact, and 空想 is itself the canonical word the novel uses (空想家 = Visionary, 空想天使 = Angel of Imagination), so a LOTM reader hears the reference immediately. Flattening it to a literal rendering throws away the whole joke.
CANON - appears in the novel. Not open to translator preference. The sequel novel. Present only as the reference 空想之环 plays off.
